finding: A02 writer and offline read capture ownership

regression.red: Retained duplicate flock description makes reopen after writer drop fail WouldBlock, including after existing 20x5ms retries.
regression.green: Explicit unlock-on-owner-drop releases ownership immediately; dropping inherited descriptor cannot release the next writer lock.
regression.scope: Deterministic shared-file-description reproduction; not a traced fork race in a real process.

changes: Writer and offline capture both use shared ExclusiveFileLock.
Writer guard is declared last so it unlocks after owned append state drops.
limits: macOS local verification; no native Linux run in this unit.
